name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Add a friend request system: send a friend request to another Federation server by address, and once they accept, both servers add each other as connected servers automatically - no more manually creating an API key and pasting it across. Each side mints the other's API key itself as part of accepting. New 'Friends' section on the config page to send requests and accept/reject/cancel pending ones.
